description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages used in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset, with each slice representing a specific language and its corresponding proportion of the total. The largest segment, colored in dark blue, represents English, which accounts for 42.8% of the data. The second largest segment, in medium blue, corresponds to Spanish, making up 31.4% of the dataset. The remaining languages are represented by smaller slices: Russian (5.7%, light blue), German (3.6%, very light blue), French (2.9%, pale blue), Chinese (2.5%, light gray), Thai (1.9%, very light gray), and Portuguese (Brazil) (1.6%, lightest gray). A final category labeled "Other" is shown in a gray segment, representing 5.8% of the total. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice, and the chart uses a color gradient from dark to light blue and gray to visually distinguish the proportions, with the largest segments positioned on the left and the smaller ones arranged clockwise toward the right.
